name: Deploy to Azure Functions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
      - qa
      - main
    paths:
      - 'pipeline/Code/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-pipelines.yml'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd pipeline/Code
          pip install -r requirements-pipeline.txt
          pip install -r ../../Code/Shared/ops/tools/requirements.txt

      - name: Derive environment from branch
        id: env
        run: |
          BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then
            echo "name=prod" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "name=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
          echo "Environment: $BRANCH"

      # Build-counter bump removed per Rule-063 + BUG-001:
      # the build is now incremented by a post-commit engineering rule on
      # every non-deploy commit, and deploys do NOT bump.

      - name: Login to Azure
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Check for active orchestrations (no overrides — blocks on any error)
        run: |
          # Rule: if we cannot CONFIRM zero active jobs, we block.
          # There are no override flags and no escape hatches.
          # The only way to unblock a deploy is to terminate the running job.

          MASTER_KEY=$(az functionapp keys list \
            --resource-group FindCareDataPipelines-Dev \
            --name ${{ secrets.AZURE_FUNCTION_APP_NAME }} \
            --query "masterKey" -o tsv 2>/dev/null) || MASTER_KEY=""

          if [ -z "$MASTER_KEY" ]; then
            echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Cannot retrieve master key — cannot verify no pipeline is running."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Flex Consumption uses a longer hostname; fetch it from Azure rather than
          # constructing <appname>.azurewebsites.net which does not resolve for FC apps.
          DEFAULT_HOST=$(az functionapp show \
            --resource-group FindCareDataPipelines-Dev \
            --name ${{ secrets.AZURE_FUNCTION_APP_NAME }} \
            --query "properties.defaultHostName" -o tsv 2>/dev/null) || DEFAULT_HOST=""

          if [ -z "$DEFAULT_HOST" ]; then
            echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Cannot retrieve app hostname — cannot verify no pipeline is running."
            exit 1
          fi

          APP_URL="https://${DEFAULT_HOST}"
          BASE="${APP_URL}/runtime/webhooks/durabletask/instances?taskHub=DevPipelineManagmentService&code=${MASTER_KEY}"

          # Kick the cold start immediately — fire-and-forget, response not checked.
          curl -s --max-time 5 "${BASE}&runtimeStatus=Running" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true

          # Poll until the app responds or 6 minutes elapse.
          # After OOM recovery the Durable extension can take 3-5 min to initialize
          # against a large task hub. Each attempt: 20s timeout. Retry every 20s.
          query_instances() {
            local status=$1
            local deadline=$((SECONDS + 360))
            while [ $SECONDS -lt $deadline ]; do
              resp=$(curl -s --max-time 20 "${BASE}&runtimeStatus=${status}" 2>/dev/null)
              if echo "$resp" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); isinstance(d,list) or sys.exit(1)" 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "$resp"
                return 0
              fi
              echo "Waiting for app warm-up (${status})..."
              sleep 20
            done
            return 1
          }

          RUNNING_RESP=$(query_instances "Running") || {
            echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Could not query running instances — cannot verify safety."
            exit 1
          }
          PENDING_RESP=$(query_instances "Pending") || {
            echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Could not query pending instances — cannot verify safety."
            exit 1
          }

          RUNNING=$(echo "$RUNNING_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sys.exit(1) if not isinstance(d,list) else print(len(d))") || { echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Unexpected Running response: $RUNNING_RESP"; exit 1; }

          PENDING=$(echo "$PENDING_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sys.exit(1) if not isinstance(d,list) else print(len(d))") || { echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Unexpected Pending response: $PENDING_RESP"; exit 1; }

          echo "Guard check — Running: ${RUNNING}  Pending: ${PENDING}"

          TOTAL=$((RUNNING + PENDING))
          if [ "$TOTAL" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: ${RUNNING} running + ${PENDING} pending orchestration(s) active."
            echo "Terminate all pipeline runs before deploying orchestrator changes."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Guard passed — no active orchestrations."

      - name: Deploy to Azure Functions
        run: |
          cd pipeline/Code
          cp requirements-pipeline.txt requirements.txt
          zip -r deploy.zip . --exclude "*.pyc" --exclude "__pycache__/*" --exclude "venv/*" --exclude "venv_func/*" --exclude "local.settings.json" --exclude ".env"
          az functionapp deployment source config-zip \
            --resource-group FindCareDataPipelines-Dev \
            --name ${{ secrets.AZURE_FUNCTION_APP_NAME }} \
            --src deploy.zip

name: Deploy Shared Services to HuggingFace

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
      - qa
      - main
    paths:
      - 'sharedServices/Code/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-shared-services.yml'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Derive Space name and env from branch
        id: space
        run: |
          BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          ORG="SkipSnow"
          BASE="SharedServicesSpace"
          if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then
            SPACE="${BASE}"
            ENV="prod"
          else
            SPACE="${BRANCH}_${BASE}"
            ENV="${BRANCH}"
          fi
          echo "name=${SPACE}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "env=${ENV}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Deploying to: ${ORG}/${SPACE} (env=${ENV})"

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Set HF Space variables + secrets (peer URLs, env, certs, signing key)
        env:
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
          HF_SPACE: ${{ steps.space.outputs.name }}
          ENV: ${{ steps.space.outputs.env }}
          # GH repo secret holding base64(shared.key) — same value across
          # dev/qa/prod (pre-alpha, 2026-05-04). Required by SharedServices'
          # _bootstrap_certs_from_env() to materialize shared.key into
          # CERTS_DIR for session-token signing.
          SHARED_SIGNING_KEY_B64: ${{ secrets.SHARED_SIGNING_KEY_B64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$ENV" = "prod" ]; then PREFIX=""; else PREFIX="${ENV}-"; fi
          FINDCARE_URL="https://skipsnow-${PREFIX}chathealthyspace.hf.space"
          EVALCARE_URL="https://skipsnow-${PREFIX}evaluatecarespace.hf.space"
          set_var() {
            K="$1"; V="$2"
            curl -s -X DELETE "https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/SkipSnow/${HF_SPACE}/secrets" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $HF_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"key\":\"${K}\"}" -o /dev/null
            curl -sf -X POST "https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/SkipSnow/${HF_SPACE}/variables" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $HF_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"key\":\"${K}\",\"value\":\"${V}\",\"description\":\"Set by deploy workflow\"}" \
              -o /dev/null && echo "  set var ${K}"
          }
          set_secret() {
            # MUST delete same-named variable + same-named secret before POST
            # — HF rejects var/secret collision and rejects POST-on-existing.
            # JSON body via python -c to immunize against shell quoting.
            K="$1"; V="$2"
            curl -s -X DELETE "https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/SkipSnow/${HF_SPACE}/variables" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $HF_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"key\":\"${K}\"}" -o /dev/null
            curl -s -X DELETE "https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/SkipSnow/${HF_SPACE}/secrets" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $HF_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"key\":\"${K}\"}" -o /dev/null
            BODY=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'key':sys.argv[1],'value':sys.argv[2],'description':'Set by deploy workflow'}))" "$K" "$V")
            HTTP=$(curl -s -X POST "https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/SkipSnow/${HF_SPACE}/secrets" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $HF_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              --data "$BODY" \
              -o /tmp/hf_resp.txt -w "%{http_code}")
            if [ "$HTTP" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP" = "201" ]; then
              echo "  set secret ${K} (http=$HTTP)"
            else
              echo "  ERROR set secret ${K}: http=$HTTP"
              cat /tmp/hf_resp.txt; echo
              return 1
            fi
          }
          set_var "ENV_PREFIX"     "${ENV}"
          set_var "FINDCARE_URL"   "${FINDCARE_URL}"
          set_var "EVALCARE_URL"   "${EVALCARE_URL}"

          # Public certs for token-level mutual auth (per SharedServices'
          # app.py _bootstrap_certs_from_env, lines 33-36):
          #   FINDCARE_CERT_PEM      peer (verifies FindCare-signed tokens)
          #   SHARED_CERT_PEM        own
          #   CA_CERT_PEM            chain
          # All public — read from repo, base64, ship as variables.
          FINDCARE_CERT_PEM_B64=$(base64 -w 0 Code/Shared/ops/certs/findcare.crt)
          SHARED_CERT_PEM_B64=$(base64 -w 0 Code/Shared/ops/certs/shared.crt)
          CA_CERT_PEM_B64=$(base64 -w 0 Code/Shared/ops/certs/ca.crt)
          set_var "FINDCARE_CERT_PEM" "${FINDCARE_CERT_PEM_B64}"
          set_var "SHARED_CERT_PEM"   "${SHARED_CERT_PEM_B64}"
          set_var "CA_CERT_PEM"       "${CA_CERT_PEM_B64}"

          # Private signing key — secret, sourced from GH repo secret.
          if [ -z "$SHARED_SIGNING_KEY_B64" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: GH repo secret SHARED_SIGNING_KEY_B64 is empty or unset."
            echo "Create it at https://github.com/SkipSnow/ChatHealthyRepo/settings/secrets/actions"
            echo "Value: base64 -w0 of Code/Shared/ops/certs/shared.key"
            exit 1
          fi
          set_secret "SHARED_SIGNING_KEY_PEM" "${SHARED_SIGNING_KEY_B64}"

      - name: Push to HuggingFace Space
        env:
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
          HF_SPACE: ${{ steps.space.outputs.name }}
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "skip.snow@gmail.com"
          git config --global user.name "SkipSnow"

          echo "Target Space: SkipSnow/${HF_SPACE}"
          git clone https://SkipSnow:$HF_TOKEN@huggingface.co/spaces/SkipSnow/${HF_SPACE} hf_space

          # Preserve README.md (HF config)
          cp hf_space/README.md /tmp/hf_readme.md 2>/dev/null || true
          find hf_space -mindepth 1 -not -path 'hf_space/.git*' -delete
          cp /tmp/hf_readme.md hf_space/README.md 2>/dev/null || true

          # Mirror sharedServices/Code/ flat into hf_space/. Same layout as
          # the Dockerfile produces inside the container — single set of
          # import statements works in both environments.
          rsync -av \
            --exclude='.env' \
            --exclude='__pycache__' \
            --exclude='*.pyc' \
            sharedServices/Code/ hf_space/

          # EPIC-003: bring FrontEndApplicationLib into the build context so the
          # Dockerfile can pip-install chathealthy-frontend-lib from a local path.
          mkdir -p hf_space/FrontEndApplicationLib
          rsync -av \
            --exclude='__pycache__' \
            --exclude='*.pyc' \
            FrontEndApplicationLib/ hf_space/FrontEndApplicationLib/

          cd hf_space
          git add .
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to deploy."
          else
            git commit -m "Deploy from GitHub commit ${{ github.sha }}"
            git push
            echo "Deployed successfully."
          fi

name: Promote Build Between Environments

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      from_env:
        description: 'Source environment'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - dev
          - qa
      to_env:
        description: 'Target environment'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - qa
          - prod
      confirm_prod:
        description: 'Confirm production promotion (GOV-007)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      dry_run:
        description: 'Dry run (print plan, no changes)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

jobs:
  promote-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Promotion merges source branch into target branch and pushes. The
    # default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only on workflow_dispatch; contents:write
    # is required for `git push origin <target>` to land.
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Validate promotion path
        run: |
          FROM="${{ inputs.from_env }}"
          TO="${{ inputs.to_env }}"
          if [ "$FROM" = "dev" ] && [ "$TO" = "qa" ]; then
            echo "Valid: dev -> qa"
          elif [ "$FROM" = "qa" ] && [ "$TO" = "prod" ]; then
            echo "Valid: qa -> prod"
            if [ "${{ inputs.confirm_prod }}" != "true" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: Production promotion requires confirm_prod=true (GOV-007)"
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "ERROR: Invalid promotion path: $FROM -> $TO"
            echo "Valid paths: dev->qa, qa->prod"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r Code/Shared/ops/tools/requirements.txt

      # Build-counter bump removed per Rule-063 + BUG-001:
      # the build is now incremented by a post-commit engineering rule on
      # every non-deploy commit, and deploys/promotions do NOT bump.

      - name: Merge source branch into target branch
        if: inputs.dry_run == false
        run: |
          BRANCH_MAP_dev="dev"
          BRANCH_MAP_qa="qa"
          BRANCH_MAP_prod="main"

          FROM_BRANCH="BRANCH_MAP_${{ inputs.from_env }}"
          TO_BRANCH="BRANCH_MAP_${{ inputs.to_env }}"
          SRC="${!FROM_BRANCH}"
          DST="${!TO_BRANCH}"

          git config user.email "skip.snow@gmail.com"
          git config user.name "SkipSnow"

          echo "Merging $SRC -> $DST"
          git checkout "$DST"
          git merge "origin/$SRC" -m "Promote ${{ inputs.from_env }} -> ${{ inputs.to_env }} (build promotion)"
          git push origin "$DST"

      - name: Dry run summary
        if: inputs.dry_run == true
        env:
          MONGO_FRONTEND_connectionString: ${{ secrets.MONGO_FRONTEND_connectionString }}
        run: |
          python Code/Shared/ops/promote_build.py \
            --from ${{ inputs.from_env }} \
            --to ${{ inputs.to_env }} \
            --dry-run
